title: Handle recurring-question ruling projections in discovery seam
description: projectCampaignRule now correctly emits recurring-question rulings as plain CampaignRuleProjection without ambiguityId or selectedInterpretationId. packages/core/src/discovery/campaignRuleSeam.ts still casts every ruleKind=ruling projection to CampaignRulingProjection when appending campaignRulings, so recurring-question rulings can enter the campaignRulings collection with an invalid shape. Update discovery behavior to distinguish ambiguity-linked rulings from recurring-question rulings while preserving the domain model.
close_reason: Fixed as part of defect 3 in commit 6759ccc: the DB seam now returns recurring-question rulings through activeRulesAtPosition, and discovery classifies only ambiguity-provenance projections as CampaignRulingProjection without fabricated ambiguity fields. Regression coverage persists a recurring ruling through the real seam and join.
